Origin and meaning

With Hebrew origins, Lisa is usually read as “pledged to God (short form of Elisabeth)”.

About the name Lisa

A short form of Elisabeth that topped US charts in the 1960s.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Lisa carries the meaning “pledged to God (short form of Elisabeth)” and looks striking in brush strokes.
